full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white fashion portrait shows a young adult from the shoulders upward, wearing a dark, heavily ornamented hat against a pale gray studio background. The background is smooth and softly graduated, with no distinct setting or readable text. The hat rises beyond the upper edge and angles over the forehead, its brim casting a strong shadow across the eyes. Small reflective studs, woven-looking sections, and raised dark embellishments make its surface dense and irregular. Beneath it, the subject turns slightly toward the right of the frame while looking directly outward. One eye catches a narrow light; the other remains partly submerged under the brim's shadow. The face has sharply modeled cheekbones, a straight nose, and a composed, unsmiling mouth. Long dark strands and textured material hang beside the left cheek and down the neck, where a slim metallic earring gives a tiny glint. At the lower edges, dark sleeveless clothing and a narrow strap disappear into the cropped frame. The skin is rendered in soft mid-grays with fine photographic grain, while the hat and neck accents approach black. Light arrives from the upper left and front, touching the cheek, nose bridge, and hat details but leaving the far side of the face much darker. A shallow depth of field preserves the eye and facial plane while gently softening the outer hat and lower clothing. The overall composition concentrates attention in the gaze and turns dense handmade adornment into a striking contrast with the quiet, pale background.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白时装肖像呈现一名年轻成年人从肩部向上的形象，戴着装饰繁密的深色帽子，背景是浅灰色摄影棚底色。背景平滑并轻轻渐变，没有明确场景或可读文字。帽子向上越出画边，斜斜压在额前，帽檐在眼部投下浓重阴影。细小反光铆钉、似编织的部分和凸起的深色饰物让表面密集而不规则。帽下人物略向画面右侧转身，目光却直视前方。一只眼睛接住一线亮光，另一只部分沉在帽檐阴影下。面部有刻画鲜明的颧骨、挺直鼻梁和平静且不微笑的嘴。深色长发丝与带肌理的材料沿左颊和颈部垂下，一枚细小金属耳饰闪出微光。下缘的深色无袖衣物和窄带消失在裁切的画边。皮肤以带细微摄影颗粒的柔和中灰呈现，帽子与颈旁饰物则接近黑色。光从左上及前方进入，照亮脸颊、鼻梁和帽上细节，面部远侧仍暗得多。浅景深保留眼睛与面部平面的清晰度，外侧帽缘和下方衣物则轻轻柔化。整体构图把注意力集中在目光上，使繁密的手工装饰与安静浅色背景形成鲜明对比。
style_prompt_en: The image has a high-contrast editorial photographic finish with restrained near-monochrome color and dense, tactile adornment. Pale matte areas and deep black clusters divide the frame into clear value zones, while small metallic glints punctuate the darkness. Directional light grazes raised textures and selectively models the focal plane, leaving neighboring surfaces in heavy shadow. Fine grain and gentle depth-of-field falloff soften the image without removing its sharpest details. Hard, jagged decorative edges contrast with smooth tonal transitions across quieter forms. The composition stays close and cropped, balancing an intricate upper mass against broad unmarked negative space. Mid-gray shading connects luminous surfaces to near-black recesses, so the dramatic contrast retains volume instead of becoming a flat cutout. The overall effect is severe, intimate, and carefully crafted.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有高反差编辑摄影质感，以克制的近单色色彩和密集可触的装饰肌理构成。浅色哑光区域与深黑聚块把画面分成清楚的明度区，小小的金属闪点刺破暗部。定向光掠过凸起肌理，选择性塑造焦点平面，让相邻表面留在浓重阴影中。细颗粒与柔和景深衰减使图像变软，却不抹去最清晰的细节。坚硬锯齿状的装饰边缘与较安静形态上的平滑色调过渡形成对比。构图贴近并裁切，以上部繁复体量平衡大片无标记留白。中灰阴影连接明亮表面与近黑凹处，使强烈反差仍保有体积，而非变成平面剪影。整体效果严峻、亲近且精心制作。
theme_en: A dark fashion portrait with an ornamented hat
theme_zh: 戴装饰礼帽的暗调时装肖像
name: Judy Blame
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
